horizontal.meaning: Maximum distance from the reference point to any point of the OpenStreetMap campus polygon (way 1147355347, version 3). It bounds the reference-point error if the Faculty lies inside that polygon, as official UMPSA material states the Faculty is at the Pekan campus.
horizontal.method: Farthest polygon vertex by spherical haversine on the IUGG mean radius

vertical.reason: DEM surface-model cell; no vertical bound for the Faculty point

coordinateReferenceEpoch.basis: Proposed 2D.3 disposition, accepted only through this artifact's approval: Plate motion of order centimetres per year is orders of magnitude below the derived horizontal bound; the reviewer decides whether that suffices

input.source: Open-Meteo elevation API, Copernicus DEM 2021 release GLO-90 (90 m); a surface model that can include buildings and canopy

heightConversion.model: EGM2008 geoid undulation from GeographicLib GeoidEval 2.5.2
heightConversion.uncertainty: UNKNOWN_UNBOUNDED for the Faculty point; the DEM product states < 4 m absolute vertical accuracy (LE90) for terrain, which does not bound a surface-model cell over buildings

provenance: OpenStreetMap API 0.6 node 12825444378 version 3, changeset 181077159, timestamp 2026-04-09T04:11:31Z

referenceEllipsoid.source: WGS 84 defining parameters (NIMA TR8350.2), as in SOFA 2023-10-11 eform

payload.referencePointDescription: The OpenStreetMap point feature 'FK Fakulti Komputeran UMPSA' (node 12825444378, version 3). It is a contributor-mapped point for the Faculty, not a surveyed monument, and not the campus centroid.
payload.siteIdentity: Faculty of Computing, UMPSA Pekan Campus, Pahang, Malaysia
